resources.string: Connects the Voyager device page in your browser to the device over a USB OTG cable or Bluetooth, for File Transfer.
Stopped. Tap Start, then open the device page.
None yet. Plug the device in with a USB OTG cable, or pair it in Bluetooth settings.
The phone must be on the device\'s WiFi (or the same network) to load the page. On the page, open File Transfer and pick the USB or Bluetooth entry in step 1.
Running. Waiting for the device page.
